name: The Rose Vigilante
source:
There is a peculiar occurrence of an alleged creep spying on unsuspecting people in the city of Valen. And the strangest part is... this masked predator only harasses boys!
You will play as Karis Papillon, a detective who believes he was demoted to this city, coincidentally where the phenomenon is happening.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200514083658/https://cloudnovel.net/OHISASHI/novel/the-rose-vigilante-demo]CloudNovel[/url]]
